chunks.phonemes: and tə ɹɪfɹˈeɪn fɹɒm ˈɔːl ˈaŋɡə and pˈaʃən. fɹʌmðə fˈeɪm and mˈɛməɹi ɒv hˌɪm ðat bɪɡˈɒt mˌiː aɪ hav lˈɜːnd bˈəʊθ ʃˈeɪmfastnəs and mˈanlaɪk bɪhˈeɪvjə.

chunks.text: Of my mother I have learned to be religious, and bountiful; and to forbear, not only to do, but to intend any evil; to content myself with a spare diet, and to fly all such excess as is incidental to great wealth.
chunks.phonemes: ɒv maɪ mˈʌðəɹ aɪ hav lˈɜːnd təbi ɹɪlˈɪdʒəs, and bˈaʊntifəl; and tə fˈɔːbeə, nˌɒt ˈəʊnli tə dˈuː, bˌʌt tʊ ɪntˈɛnd ˌɛni ˈiːvəl; tə kəntˈɛnt maɪsˈɛlf wɪð ɐ spˈeə dˈaɪət, and tə flˈaɪ ˈɔːl sˈʌtʃ ɛksˈɛs ˌazˌɪz ˌɪnsɪdˈɛntəl tə ɡɹˈeɪt wˈɛlθ.

chunks.text: Of my great-grandfather, both to frequent public schools and auditories, and to get me good and able teachers at home; and that I ought not to think much, if upon such occasions, I were at excessive charges.
chunks.phonemes: ɒv maɪ ɡɹˈeɪtɡɹˈandfɑːðə, bˈəʊθ tə fɹˈiːkwənt pˈʌblɪk skˈuːlz and ˈɔːdɪtəɹiz, and tə ɡɛt mˌiː ɡˈʊd and ˈeɪbəl tˈiːtʃəz at hˈəʊm; and ðat aɪ ˈɔːt nˌɒt tə θˈɪŋk mˈʌtʃ, ɪf əpˌɒn sˈʌtʃ əkˈeɪʒənz, aɪ wɜːɹ at ɛksˈɛsɪv tʃˈɑːdʒɪz.

chunks.text: Of him that brought me up, not to be fondly addicted to either of the two great factions of the coursers in the circus, called Prasini, and Veneti: nor in the amphitheatre partially to favour any of the gladiators, or fencers, as either the Parmularii, or the Secutores.
chunks.phonemes: ɒv hˌɪm ðat bɹˈɔːt mˌiː ˈʌp, nˌɒt təbi fˈɒndli ɐdˈɪktɪd tʊ ˈaɪðəɹ ɒvðə tˈuː ɡɹˈeɪt fˈakʃənz ɒvðə kˈɔːsəz ɪnðə sˈɜːkəs, kˈɔːld pɹasˈiːnɪ, and vɛnˈɛti: nˈɔːɹ ɪnðɪ ˈamfɪθˌiətə pˈɑːʃəli tə fˈeɪvəɹ ˌɛni ɒvðə ɡlˈadɪˌeɪtəz, ɔː fˈɛnsəz, az ˈaɪðə ðə pˈɑːmjʊlˌɑːɹɪˌaɪ, ɔː ðə sˈɛkjuːtəz.
